neighborhood: all adjacent pairs within maximal same-machine blocks of one deterministic critical path; infeasible cyclic swaps rejected
tabu_aspiration: candidate makespan strictly below incumbent best
tie_break: local seeded random, no global RNG
reward: (start incumbent best - endpoint incumbent best) / initial feasible makespan
cost: all attempted neighbor DAG decodes, initial current+best state decodes, actual accepted moves and wall time; no dummy evaluations
scope: independent implementation replication, no claim of novel tabu algorithm
